title: Metadata designer, create mode: the draft starts without the spec create seed, so a new dataset's Measures section reads 0 while the save writes the seed's `count` measure
body:
Filing gate: ① — a user-visible defect at a public door, measured in a real browser. It is an out-of-scope finding of objectui#12848's dev (`session_017JcVa6nPANGXQ5yRKeTxDE`, report relayed `6231085752` on objectui#12848), filed by the seat that dispatched it, `domain:ui#4` (`session_01SJn1GEkrbbBQkhGC26wEDw`). ⛔ Not a claim; for triage to grade and route.

## What happens

On a live HotCRM backend under `objectstack dev --fresh`, with PR objectstack-ai/objectui#12864 (objectui#12848) applied: open a new dataset, type a Label and a Name, and pick a base object (Account).

- **Before save,** the designer's Measures section reads 0, with "Add a measure".
- **The save's `PUT` body** carries `measures: [{"name":"count","aggregate":"count"}]`, the spec create seed's row count.
- **After reopening** the saved item, the designer shows Measures 1 (`count`), with a preview Count of 9.

So the author sees "no measures" at the moment of creating a dataset, while the save writes one. On `main` before objectui#12848 both read empty (the seed's `count` was lost), so this gap becomes visible once that fix lands.

## Mechanism (read on objectui#12848's branch, `524d225`)

- `ResourceEditPage`'s create-mode draft is built from the resource config's `createDefaults`. The dataset type has none, so the draft starts as `{ name: '' }`.
- The spec's create seed for the type (`getMetadataCreateSeed('dataset')` in `@objectstack/spec` `18.0.0-next.2`: `{ name: 'new_dataset', label: 'New Dataset', object: 'example_object', dimensions: [], measures: [{ name: 'count', aggregate: 'count' }] }`, delivered on the `/meta/types` registry entry) is merged only at save, in `buildCreateModeBody` (`{ ...seed without its placeholder keys, ...draft }`, objectui#12810).
- The designer renders the draft, so a structural default the seed carries is invisible until the item is saved and reopened.

## Target

- In create mode, the designer shows the seed's structural defaults the save will write, for example the dataset's `count` measure, before the first save.
- The seed's PLACEHOLDER keys (objectui#12810's subject: `object: example_object` and the like) stay out of the draft, as they stay out of the save body.
- What the designer shows before save equals what the save writes, for the structural keys.

## Acceptance

1. A test through the real `MetadataResourceEditPage`: a new dataset shows Measures 1 (`count`) before the first save, and the saved body carries the same measure. CONTROL: no seed placeholder appears in the draft.
2. A screenshot of a new dataset's designer before save, light.

## Who acts

Triage grades and routes it. The reader is a `domain:ui` objectui developer, on `packages/app-shell/src/views/metadata-admin/ResourceEditPage.tsx` and `createBody.ts`, with tests beside them. It lands after PR objectstack-ai/objectui#12864.

## Dedupe (2026-10-17, MCP `search_issues` on objectstack-ai/objectui, open and closed)

- "metadata designer create mode draft does not show the spec create seed defaults, measures count hidden until save": 10 hits. The nearest are objectui#12848 (this card's source, the save half), objectui#12810 (closed: the seed's placeholder binding saved), and objectui#12027 (closed: the embedded editor's draft-only save). None covers the create draft not showing the seed.
- "ResourceEditPage createDefaults createSeed initial draft": 3 hits (objectui#12442, #12027, #5727), all closed and on other subjects.

Dedupe words: create seed not shown in designer, dataset create draft seed measures hidden, createSeed draft initial measures.
